response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS avg_of_avg_remaincount, SUM(exec_count) AS total_executions FROM (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_remain, COUNT(*) AS exec_count FROM orderexecutions WHERE CAST(expirespot AS TEXT) > '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND CAST(expirespot AS TEXT) < '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY ordersmark) AS per_order

assumptions.assumption: Executions with a NULL ordersmark form their own group and count as one 'order' in the per-order grouping, since GROUP BY keeps NULL as a group.
The number of executions per order is COUNT(*) of the qualifying rows, including rows where remaincount is NULL.
The text comparison is lexicographic on the stored timestamp text, as the request specifies.
